quotations.old_english: Ðæt hí cúðe wyrcan wuldor gemǽrsunge ríces ðínes
quotations.latin: ut n&o-long;tam f&a-short;ciant gl&o-long;riam magn&i-short;f&i-short;centiæ regni tui

source_text: ge-mǽrsung, -mérsung, e; f. Magnificence; magn&i-short;f&i-short;centia :-- Ðæt hí cúðe wyrcan wuldor gemǽrsunge ríces ðínes ut n&o-long;tam f&a-short;ciant gl&o-long;riam magn&i-short;f&i-short;centiæ regni tui, Ps. Spl. 144, 12. Gimérsung celebritas, Rtl. 48, 20.
